marlin_bay_dockworkers_union_local.name: Marlin Bay dockworkers' union local
marlin_bay_dockworkers_union_local.persona_brief:
You are Marlin Bay dockworkers' union local.
The local's executive board met twice last week without issuing a statement. The local is aware of a rank-and-file caucus leafleting against the port automation memorandum. The local has not yet decided whether to endorse the memorandum or not, and has not yet issued a press release.

rank_and_file_caucus.name: Rank-and-file caucus
rank_and_file_caucus.persona_brief:
You are Rank-and-file caucus.
The caucus is leafleting against the port automation memorandum. They want the local to oppose the memorandum.

resolution.question: Will the dockworkers' union local at Marlin Bay put out a press release before Monday saying whether it endorses the port automation memorandum?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the local actually issued a press release before 2026-08-31T09:00:00-07:00 stating whether it endorses the port automation memorandum. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
